lines.en: My hooves clop over the basalt.

lines.zh: 我一步步走向有动静的地方
lines.en: I head toward the noise, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲在火光里发亮
lines.en: My pauldrons catch the firelight.
I shove a lava rock out of my way.
I advance without hesitation.
My footsteps are louder than the fire.
I trample through the ash.
I skirt the lava pit.
My shadow wavers in the heat.
I bear down on you, step by step.
I turn, and every plate rings.
I head where you went.
I stand, and fire burns beside me.
The fire in my chest crackles.
I will not have to wait long.
I watch the lava flow past.
Smoke curls off my horns.
I have walked this level a great deal.
I shake the ash off my horns.
This heat is comfortable.
I stretch my neck.
I listen to something above.
No ash gathers on my armour.
I have always kept this level.
Your heartbeat is loud enough to bother me.
I lean down to get a good look at you.
You stand on my level.
Your weapon is too small.
I know that stance.
Run, and I will not chase long.
My horns are pointed at you.
You are a little taller than the last one.
The moment you raise it, I see.
Back there and there is no way out.
My armour is dented.
I give half a pace of ground.
A plate of my armor broke off.
My brow shifts.
I shake the sparks off my armor.
I shake the ash off my hand.
You knocked my horns aside.
I will count that against you.
One of my plates rings.
My knee clicked once.
Not enough - I want lava.
Lava is my food.
Why hold that up?
Right now I want only blood.
Put it away while you can.
There's nothing but fire in my gut.
That's not enough to get stuck in my teeth.
You've held it up too long.
I have no interest in that.
You keep such things yourself.
You hit my armour.
I stand my ground without shifting a hoof.
You bounce off into the rock.
My hoof rakes your leg.
Your head barely reaches my knee.
You hit me like a stone pillar.
I step one pace aside.
The slab cracks under me.
My tail sweeps past.
I have your position now.
There is no such thing in Hell.

lines.zh: 我是为了打才被造出来的
lines.en: I was made for fighting.
Do not waste my time.
I can only tell enemies apart.
I turn my body away.
This level has no use for that.
You are asking the wrong thing.
I pound my fist on the stone.
There is no need to say that again.
I walk off toward the lava.
I take whatever falls into the ash.
I pinch it up and look.
I kick the scrap iron out of my way.
I toss it into the lava.
It's smoking in my palm.
Whoever dropped it, it is not mine.
I grind it into the ash.
I keep it; it might serve as a hammer.
This weight is nothing.
I could hold this in one hand.
Your footsteps carry a long way.
There is no way for you to escape.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向迈了一步
lines.en: I take one step your way.
You are the only living thing left on this level.

lines.zh: 你身上已经有我的标记
lines.en: My mark is on you already.
My horns have lowered.
I have no need to shout.
Do you hear my hooves?
Fire burns at my back.
I have picked you.
You are easy to spot.
I am coming through now.
I cannot hold back this time.
Do not back toward the lava.
The ground sinks with each step I take.
Your heels have hit the wall.
My plates keep ringing.
The heat will soften you up first.
My horns aim at your chest.
You will not block the second.
The heat here is bad for you.
Two more steps and you're in reach.
The heat at that wall scalds your back.
Two more steps forward.
Lava light glints off my teeth.
Do you hear the fire?
My fist is up.
Whatever you do, do not stop.
I am ready on my side.
You are drenched in sweat.
My fist comes down.
The blow drops you to your knees.
That punch carried the heat of lava.

lines.zh: 我的拳头把你砸进灰里
lines.en: My fist drives you into the ash.
You fall back, and I follow.
Armour ringing, and I keep moving.
You blocked, and your arms went numb.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩碎了你的盾
lines.en: My hoof shattered your shield.
Blood steams on the stone.
I lift my hoof.
You are driven into the ash.
I bring one more blow down.
My hoof splits the slab.
You will not get up.
This level is only so big.
I am still planted here.
I step out from beside the lava.
One more suit of armour on this level.
Firelight rises behind me.
I lower my horns and step in.
The Nether welcomes me back.
My hooves arrive before I do.
Ash falls off me.
I am in position.

lines.zh: 这里的声音我都听清了
lines.en: I have heard every sound here.
I do not know the word retreat.
I slowly scan the area.
This level has something living on it.
This fire is weak as a breeze.
I am knocked off the ledge.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，冒起白烟
lines.en: Water hits me and steam rises.

lines.zh: 爆风扯掉了我一块甲片
lines.en: The blast tore a plate off my armor.
A round strikes my chest.
Magic works into my seams.
I have not drunk lava in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，甲都亮了
lines.en: Lightning lights up my armour.
The ledge is gone.
